verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָל֛וּ עִם־ זְרֻבָּבֶ֥ל בֶּן־ שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֖ל וְיֵשׁ֑וּעַ שְׂרָיָ֥ה יִרְמְיָ֖ה עֶזְרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim ’ă·šer ‘ā·lū ‘im- zə·rub·bā·ḇel ben- šə·’al·tî·’êl wə·yê·šū·a‘ śə·rā·yāh yir·mə·yāh ‘ez·rā
verses.literal: Now these are the priests and Levites who went up with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and with Jeshua Seraiah Jeremiah Ezra

verses.original: אֲמַרְיָ֥ה מַלּ֖וּךְ חַטּֽוּשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·mar·yāh mal·lūḵ ḥaṭ·ṭūš
verses.literal: Amariah Malluch Hattush

verses.original: שְׁכַנְיָ֥ה רְחֻ֖ם מְרֵמֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ḵan·yāh rə·ḥum mə·rê·mōṯ
verses.literal: Shecaniah Rehum Meremoth

verses.original: עִדּ֥וֹא גִנְּת֖וֹי אֲבִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘id·dō·w ḡin·nə·ṯō·w ’ă·ḇî·yāh
verses.literal: Iddo Ginnethon Abijah

verses.original: מִיָּמִ֥ין מַֽעַדְיָ֖ה בִּלְגָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mî·yā·mîn ma·‘aḏ·yāh bil·gāh
verses.literal: Mijamin Maadiah Bilgah

verses.original: שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה וְיוֹיָרִ֖יב יְדַֽעְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘·yāh wə·yō·w·yā·rîḇ yə·ḏa‘·yāh
verses.literal: Shemaiah Joiarib Jedaiah

verses.original: סַלּ֣וּ עָמ֔וֹק חִלְקִיָּ֖ה יְדַֽעְיָ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֧י הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם בִּימֵ֥י יֵשֽׁוּעַ׃פ
verses.transliteration: sal·lū ‘ā·mō·wq ḥil·qî·yāh yə·ḏa‘·yāh ’êl·leh rā·šê hak·kō·hă·nîm wa·’ă·ḥê·hem bî·mê yê·šū·a‘
verses.literal: Sallu Amok Hilkiah [and] Jedaiah These were the leaders of the priests and their associates in the days of Jeshua

verses.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֗ם יֵשׁ֧וּעַ בִּנּ֛וּי קַדְמִיאֵ֥ל שֵׁרֵבְיָ֖ה יְהוּדָ֣ה מַתַּנְיָ֑ה ה֥וּא וְאֶחָֽיו׃ עַֽל־ הֻיְּד֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: wə·hal·wî·yim yê·šū·a‘ bin·nui qaḏ·mî·’êl šê·rê·ḇə·yāh yə·hū·ḏāh mat·tan·yāh hū wə·’e·ḥāw ‘al- h·yə·ḏō·wṯ
verses.literal: The Levites [were] Jeshua Binnui Kadmiel Sherebiah Judah and Mattaniah who with his associates led the songs of thanksgiving

verses.original: וּבַקְבֻּֽקְיָ֨ה וְעֻנּוֹ אֲחֵיהֶ֛ם לְנֶגְדָּ֖ם לְמִשְׁמָרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇaq·buq·yāh wə·ʿun·nō ’ă·ḥê·hem lə·neḡ·dām lə·miš·mā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: Bakbukiah and Unni their associates [stood] across from them in the services

verses.original: וְיֵשׁ֖וּעַ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יֽוֹיָקִ֑ים וְיֽוֹיָקִים֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ אֶלְיָשִׁ֔יב וְאֶלְיָשִׁ֖יב אֶת־ יוֹיָדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·šū·a‘ hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- yō·w·yā·qîm wə·yō·w·yā·qîm hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- ’el·yā·šîḇ wə·’el·yā·šîḇ ’eṯ- yō·w·yā·ḏā‘
verses.literal: Jeshua was the father of - Joiakim Joiakim was the father of - Eliashib Eliashib - was the father of Joiada

verses.original: וְיוֹיָדָע֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יוֹנָתָ֔ן וְיוֹנָתָ֖ן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ יַדּֽוּעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·yā·ḏā‘ hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- yō·w·nā·ṯān wə·yō·w·nā·ṯān hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- yad·dū·a‘
verses.literal: Joiada was the father of - Jonathan and Jonathan was the father of - Jaddua

verses.original: וּבִימֵי֙ יֽוֹיָקִ֔ים הָי֥וּ רָאשֵׁ֣י כֹהֲנִ֖ים הָאָב֑וֹת לִשְׂרָיָ֣ה מְרָיָ֔ה לְיִרְמְיָ֖ה חֲנַנְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇî·mê yō·w·yā·qîm hā·yū rā·šê ḵō·hă·nîm hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ liś·rā·yāh mə·rā·yāh lə·yir·mə·yāh ḥă·nan·yāh
verses.literal: In the days of Joiakim these were the heads of the priestly families of [the family of] Seraiah Meraiah of Jeremiah Hananiah

verses.original: לְעֶזְרָ֣א מְשֻׁלָּ֔ם לַאֲמַרְיָ֖ה יְהוֹחָנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: lə·‘ez·rā mə·šul·lām la·’ă·mar·yāh yə·hō·w·ḥā·nān
verses.literal: of Ezra Meshullam of Amariah Jehohanan

verses.original: לִמְלוּכִי יֽוֹנָתָ֔ן לִשְׁבַנְיָ֖ה יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: lim·lū·ḵī yō·w·nā·ṯān liš·ḇan·yāh yō·w·sêp̄
verses.literal: of Malluchi Jonathan of Shebaniah Joseph

verses.original: לְחָרִ֣ם עַדְנָ֔א לִמְרָי֖וֹת חֶלְקָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḥā·rim ‘aḏ·nā lim·rā·yō·wṯ ḥel·qāy
verses.literal: of Harim Adna of Meraioth Helkai

verses.original: לַעֲדָיָא זְכַרְיָ֖ה לְגִנְּת֥וֹן מְשֻׁלָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: la·ʿă·ḏå̄·yå̄ zə·ḵar·yāh lə·ḡin·nə·ṯō·wn mə·šul·lām
verses.literal: of Iddo Zechariah of Ginnethon Meshullam

verses.original: לַאֲבִיָּ֖ה זִכְרִ֑י לְמִ֨נְיָמִ֔ין לְמוֹעַדְיָ֖ה פִּלְטָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: la·’ă·ḇî·yāh ziḵ·rî lə·min·yā·mîn lə·mō·w·‘aḏ·yāh pil·ṭāy
verses.literal: of Abijah Zichri of Miniamin and of Moadiah Piltai

verses.original: לְבִלְגָּ֣ה שַׁמּ֔וּעַ לִֽשְׁמַעְיָ֖ה יְהוֹנָתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḇil·gāh šam·mū·a‘ liš·ma‘·yāh yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān
verses.literal: of Bilgah Shammua of Shemaiah Jonathan

verses.original: וּלְיוֹיָרִ֣יב מַתְּנַ֔י לִֽידַֽעְיָ֖ה עֻזִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·yō·w·yā·rîḇ mat·tə·nay lî·ḏa‘·yāh ‘uz·zî
verses.literal: of Joiarib Mattenai of Jedaiah Uzzi

verses.original: לְסַלַּ֥י קַלָּ֖י לְעָמ֥וֹק עֵֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: lə·sal·lay qal·lāy lə·‘ā·mō·wq ‘ê·ḇer
verses.literal: of Sallai Kallai of Amok Eber

verses.original: לְחִלְקִיָּ֣ה חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה לִֽידַֽעְיָ֖ה נְתַנְאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḥil·qî·yāh ḥă·šaḇ·yāh lî·ḏa‘·yāh nə·ṯan·’êl
verses.literal: of Hilkiah Hashabiah [and] of Jedaiah Nethanel

verses.original: בִּימֵ֨י אֶלְיָשִׁ֜יב יוֹיָדָ֤ע וְיוֹחָנָן֙ וְיַדּ֔וּעַ עַל־ מַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ הַפָּֽרְסִֽי׃פ רָאשֵׁ֣י אָב֑וֹת הַלְוִיִּם֩ וְהַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים כְּתוּבִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: bî·mê ’el·yā·šîḇ yō·w·yā·ḏā‘ wə·yō·w·ḥā·nān wə·yad·dū·a‘ ‘al- mal·ḵūṯ dā·rə·yā·weš hap·pā·rə·sî rā·šê ’ā·ḇō·wṯ hal·wî·yim wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm kə·ṯū·ḇîm
verses.literal: In the days of Eliashib Joiada Johanan and Jaddua during the reign of Darius the Persian the heads of the families of the Levites and priests were recorded

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י לֵוִי֙ הָֽאָב֔וֹת רָאשֵׁ֣י וְעַד־ יְמֵ֖י יֽוֹחָנָ֥ן בֶּן־ אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב׃ כְּתוּבִ֕ים עַל־ סֵ֖פֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י הַיָּמִ֑ים
verses.transliteration: bə·nê lê·wî hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ rā·šê wə·‘aḏ- yə·mê yō·w·ḥā·nān ben- ’el·yā·šîḇ kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: As for the descendants of Levi the family heads up to the days of Johanan son of Eliashib were recorded in the Book of the Chronicles . . .

verses.original: וְרָאשֵׁ֣י הַ֠לְוִיִּם חֲשַׁבְיָ֨ה שֵֽׁרֵבְיָ֜ה וְיֵשׁ֤וּעַ בֶּן־ קַדְמִיאֵל֙ וַאֲחֵיהֶ֣ם לְנֶגְדָּ֔ם לְהַלֵּ֣ל לְהוֹד֔וֹת מִשְׁמָ֖ר לְעֻמַּ֥ת מִשְׁמָֽר׃ בְּמִצְוַ֖ת דָּוִ֣יד אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·šê hal·wî·yim ḥă·šaḇ·yāh šê·rê·ḇə·yāh wə·yê·šū·a‘ ben- qaḏ·mî·’êl wa·’ă·ḥê·hem lə·neḡ·dām lə·hal·lêl lə·hō·w·ḏō·wṯ miš·mār lə·‘um·maṯ miš·mār bə·miṣ·waṯ dā·wîḏ ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: The leaders of the Levites [were] Hashabiah Sherebiah and Jeshua son of Kadmiel along with their associates [who stood] across from them to give praise and thanksgiving as one section alternated with the other as prescribed by David the man of God

verses.original: מַתַּנְיָ֧ה וּבַקְבֻּֽקְיָ֛ה עֹבַדְיָ֥ה מְשֻׁלָּ֖ם טַלְמ֣וֹן עַקּ֑וּב שֽׁוֹעֲרִים֙ שֹׁמְרִ֤ים מִשְׁמָ֔ר בַּאֲסֻפֵּ֖י הַשְּׁעָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: mat·tan·yāh ū·ḇaq·buq·yāh ‘ō·ḇaḏ·yāh mə·šul·lām ṭal·mō·wn ‘aq·qūḇ šō·w·‘ă·rîm šō·mə·rîm miš·mār ba·’ă·sup·pê haš·šə·‘ā·rîm
verses.literal: Mattaniah Bakbukiah Obadiah Meshullam Talmon [and] Akkub [were] gatekeepers who guarded . . . the storerooms at the gates

verses.original: אֵ֕לֶּה בִּימֵ֛י יוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־ יֵשׁ֖וּעַ בֶּן־ יוֹצָדָ֑ק וּבִימֵי֙ נְחֶמְיָ֣ה הַפֶּחָ֔ה וְעֶזְרָ֥א הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַסּוֹפֵֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh bî·mê yō·w·yā·qîm ben- yê·šū·a‘ ben- yō·w·ṣā·ḏāq ū·ḇî·mê nə·ḥem·yāh hap·pe·ḥāh wə·‘ez·rā hak·kō·hên has·sō·w·p̄êr
verses.literal: They [served] in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua the son of Jozadak and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and Ezra the priest and scribe

verses.original: וּבַחֲנֻכַּ֞ת חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הַלְוִיִּם֙ בִּקְשׁ֤וּ אֶת־ מִכָּל־ מְק֣וֹמֹתָ֔ם לַהֲבִיאָ֖ם לִֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לַעֲשֹׂ֨ת וְשִׂמְחָה֙ חֲנֻכָּ֤ה וּבְתוֹד֣וֹת וּבְשִׁ֔יר מְצִלְתַּ֖יִם נְבָלִ֥ים וּבְכִנֹּרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇa·ḥă·nuk·kaṯ ḥō·w·maṯ yə·rū·šā·lim hal·wî·yim biq·šū ’eṯ- mik·kāl mə·qō·w·mō·ṯām la·hă·ḇî·’ām lî·rū·šā·lim la·‘ă·śōṯ wə·śim·ḥāh ḥă·nuk·kāh ū·ḇə·ṯō·w·ḏō·wṯ ū·ḇə·šîr mə·ṣil·ta·yim nə·ḇā·lîm ū·ḇə·ḵin·nō·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem the Levites were sought out - from all their homes and brought to Jerusalem to celebrate the joyous dedication with thanksgiving and singing accompanied by cymbals harps and lyres

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים וַיֵּאָ֣סְפ֔וּ וּמִן־ הַכִּכָּר֙ סְבִיב֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּמִן־ חַצְרֵ֖י נְטֹפָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ham·šō·rə·rîm way·yê·’ā·sə·p̄ū ū·min- hak·kik·kār sə·ḇî·ḇō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim ū·min- ḥaṣ·rê nə·ṭō·p̄ā·ṯî
verses.literal: vvv The singers were also assembled from the region around Jerusalem from the villages of the Netophathites

verses.original: וּמִבֵּית֙ הַגִּלְגָּ֔ל וּמִשְּׂד֥וֹת גֶּ֖בַע וְעַזְמָ֑וֶת כִּ֣י הַמְשֹׁ֣רֲרִ֔ים בָּנ֤וּ חֲצֵרִ֗ים לָהֶם֙ סְבִיב֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bêṯ hag·gil·gāl ū·miś·śə·ḏō·wṯ ge·ḇa‘ wə·‘az·mā·weṯ kî ham·šō·ră·rîm bā·nū ḥă·ṣê·rîm lā·hem sə·ḇî·ḇō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: from Beth-gilgal . . . and from the fields of Geba and Azmaveth for [they] had built villages for themselves around Jerusalem

verses.original: הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֑ם וַיִּֽטַּהֲר֔וּ וַֽיְטַהֲרוּ֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם וְאֶת־ הַשְּׁעָרִ֖ים וְאֶֽת־ הַחוֹמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim way·yiṭ·ṭa·hă·rū way·ṭa·hă·rū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām wə·’eṯ- haš·šə·‘ā·rîm wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥō·w·māh
verses.literal: After the priests and Levites had purified themselves they purified - the people - the gates - and the wall

verses.original: שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וָאַעֲלֶה֙ אֶת־ מֵעַ֖ל לַחוֹמָ֑ה וָאַעֲמִ֡ידָה שְׁתֵּ֣י גְּדוֹלֹ֨ת תוֹדֹת֩ וְתַהֲלֻכֹ֤ת מֵעַ֣ל לַחוֹמָ֔ה לַיָּמִין֙ הָאַשְׁפֹּֽת׃ לְשַׁ֖עַר
verses.transliteration: śā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh wā·’a·‘ă·leh ’eṯ- mê·‘al la·ḥō·w·māh wā·’a·‘ă·mî·ḏāh šə·tê gə·ḏō·w·lōṯ ṯō·w·ḏōṯ wə·ṯa·hă·lu·ḵōṯ mê·‘al la·ḥō·w·māh lay·yā·mîn hā·’aš·pōṯ lə·ša·‘ar
verses.literal: Then I brought the leaders of Judah up - on the wall and I appointed two great thanksgiving [choirs] One was to proceed along the top of the wall to the right toward the Dung Gate

verses.original: הוֹשַׁ֣עְיָ֔ה וַחֲצִ֖י שָׂרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ אַחֲרֵיהֶם֙
verses.transliteration: hō·wō·ša‘·yāh wa·ḥă·ṣî śā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh way·yê·leḵ ’a·ḥă·rê·hem
verses.literal: Hoshaiah and half the leaders of Judah followed . . .

verses.original: וַעֲזַרְיָ֥ה עֶזְרָ֖א וּמְשֻׁלָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·zar·yāh ‘ez·rā ū·mə·šul·lām
verses.literal: along with Azariah Ezra Meshullam

verses.original: יְהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֖ה וְיִרְמְיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇin·yā·min ū·šə·ma‘·yāh wə·yir·mə·yāh
verses.literal: Judah Benjamin Shemaiah Jeremiah

verses.original: הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וּמִבְּנֵ֥י בַּחֲצֹצְר֑וֹת זְכַרְיָ֨ה בֶן־ יֽוֹנָתָ֜ן בֶּן־ שְׁמַֽעְיָ֗ה בֶּן־ מַתַּנְיָה֙ בֶּן־ מִ֣יכָיָ֔ה בֶּן־ זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן־ אָסָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hă·nîm ū·mib·bə·nê ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ zə·ḵar·yāh ḇen- yō·w·nā·ṯān ben- šə·ma‘·yāh ben- mat·tan·yāh ben- mî·ḵā·yāh ben- zak·kūr ben- ’ā·sāp̄
verses.literal: and some of the priests . . . with trumpets and also Zechariah son of Jonathan the son of Shemaiah the son of Mattaniah the son of Micaiah the son of Zaccur the son of Asaph

verses.original: וְֽאֶחָ֡יו שְֽׁמַעְיָ֡ה וַעֲזַרְאֵ֡ל מִֽלֲלַ֡י גִּֽלֲלַ֡י מָעַ֞י נְתַנְאֵ֤ל וִֽיהוּדָה֙ חֲנָ֔נִי שִׁ֥יר בִּכְלֵי־ דָּוִ֖יד אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעֶזְרָ֥א הַסּוֹפֵ֖ר לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’e·ḥāw šə·ma‘·yāh wa·‘ă·zar·’êl mi·lă·lay gi·lă·lay mā·‘ay nə·ṯan·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh ḥă·nā·nî šîr biḵ·lê- dā·wîḏ ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·‘ez·rā has·sō·w·p̄êr lip̄·nê·hem
verses.literal: and his associates Shemaiah Azarel Milalai Gilalai Maai Nethanel Judah and Hanani with the musical instruments [prescribed by] David the man of God Ezra the scribe led the procession

verses.original: וְעַל֩ הָעַ֜יִן וְנֶגְדָּ֗ם שַׁ֨עַר עָלוּ֙ עַֽל־ מַעֲלוֹת֙ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד בַּֽמַּעֲלֶ֖ה לַחוֹמָ֑ה מֵעַל֙ לְבֵ֣ית דָּוִ֔יד וְעַ֛ד הַמַּ֖יִם שַׁ֥עַר מִזְרָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al hā·‘a·yin wə·neḡ·dām ša·‘ar ‘ā·lū ‘al- ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ ‘îr dā·wîḏ bam·ma·‘ă·leh la·ḥō·w·māh mê·‘al lə·ḇêṯ dā·wîḏ wə·‘aḏ ham·ma·yim ša·‘ar miz·rāḥ
verses.literal: At the Fountain . . . Gate they went directly up . . . the steps of the City of David on the ascent to the wall and passed above the house of David to the Water Gate on the east

verses.original: הַשֵּׁנִ֛ית וְהַתּוֹדָ֧ה הַהוֹלֶ֥כֶת לְמ֖וֹאל וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲרֶ֑יהָ וַחֲצִ֨י הָעָ֜ם מֵעַ֣ל לְהַחוֹמָ֗ה מֵעַל֙ לְמִגְדַּ֣ל הַתַּנּוּרִ֔ים וְעַ֖ד הָרְחָבָֽה׃ הַחוֹמָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: haš·šê·nîṯ wə·hat·tō·w·ḏāh ha·hō·w·le·ḵeṯ lə·mō·wl wa·’ă·nî ’a·ḥă·re·hā wa·ḥă·ṣî hā·‘ām mê·‘al lə·ha·ḥō·w·māh mê·‘al lə·miḡ·dal hat·tan·nū·rîm wə·‘aḏ hā·rə·ḥā·ḇāh ha·ḥō·w·māh
verses.literal: The second thanksgiving [choir] proceeded to the left and I followed it with half the people along the top of the wall past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall

verses.original: וּמֵעַ֣ל לְשַֽׁעַר־ אֶ֠פְרַיִם וְעַל־ הַיְשָׁנָ֜ה שַׁ֨עַר וְעַל־ הַדָּגִ֗ים שַׁ֣עַר וּמִגְדַּ֤ל חֲנַנְאֵל֙ וּמִגְדַּ֣ל הַמֵּאָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד הַצֹּ֑אן שַׁ֣עַר וְעָ֣מְד֔וּ בְּשַׁ֖עַר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·‘al lə·ša·‘ar- ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·‘al- hay·šā·nāh ša·‘ar wə·‘al- had·dā·ḡîm ša·‘ar ū·miḡ·dal ḥă·nan·’êl ū·miḡ·dal ham·mê·’āh wə·‘aḏ haṣ·ṣōn ša·‘ar wə·‘ā·mə·ḏū bə·ša·‘ar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh
verses.literal: over the Gate of Ephraim - the Jeshanah Gate . . . the Fish Gate the Tower of Hananel and the Tower of the Hundred as far as the Sheep Gate And they stopped at the Gate of the Guard

verses.original: שְׁתֵּ֥י הַתּוֹדֹ֖ת וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֛דְנָה בְּבֵ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַאֲנִ֕י וַחֲצִ֥י הַסְּגָנִ֖ים עִמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šə·tê hat·tō·w·ḏōṯ wat·ta·‘ă·mō·ḏə·nāh bə·ḇêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wa·’ă·nî wa·ḥă·ṣî has·sə·ḡā·nîm ‘im·mî
verses.literal: The two thanksgiving [choirs] then stood in the house of God as did I along with the half of the officials accompanying me

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים בַּחֲצֹצְרֽוֹת׃ אֶלְיָקִ֡ים מַעֲשֵׂיָ֡ה מִ֠נְיָמִין מִיכָיָ֧ה אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֛י זְכַרְיָ֥ה חֲנַנְיָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ ’el·yā·qîm ma·‘ă·śê·yāh min·yā·mîn mî·ḵā·yāh ’el·yō·w·‘ê·nay zə·ḵar·yāh ḥă·nan·yāh
verses.literal: as well as the priests with their trumpets Eliakim Maaseiah Miniamin Micaiah Elioenai Zechariah and Hananiah

verses.original: וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֨ה וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר וְעֻזִּ֛י וִֽיהוֹחָנָ֥ן וּמַלְכִּיָּ֖ה וְעֵילָ֣ם וָעָ֑זֶר הַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים וַיַּשְׁמִ֙יעוּ֙ הַפָּקִֽיד׃ וְיִֽזְרַחְיָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ū·ma·‘ă·śê·yāh ū·šə·ma‘·yāh wə·’el·‘ā·zār wə·‘uz·zî wî·hō·w·ḥā·nān ū·mal·kî·yāh wə·‘ê·lām wā·‘ā·zer ham·šō·rə·rîm way·yaš·mî·‘ū hap·pā·qîḏ wə·yiz·raḥ·yāh
verses.literal: and also Maaseiah Shemaiah Eleazar Uzzi Jehohanan Malchijah Elam and Ezer Then the choirs sang out under the direction of Jezrahiah

verses.original: הַ֠הוּא בַיּוֹם־ וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ גְּדוֹלִ֜ים זְבָחִ֨ים וַיִּשְׂמָ֗חוּ כִּ֤י הָאֱלֹהִים֙ גְדוֹלָ֔ה שִׂמְּחָם֙ שִׂמְחָ֣ה הַנָּשִׁ֛ים וְהַיְלָדִ֖ים וְגַ֧ם שָׂמֵ֑חוּ שִׂמְחַ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַתִּשָּׁמַ֛ע מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū ḇay·yō·wm- way·yiz·bə·ḥū gə·ḏō·w·lîm zə·ḇā·ḥîm way·yiś·mā·ḥū kî hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh śim·mə·ḥām śim·ḥāh han·nā·šîm wə·hay·lā·ḏîm wə·ḡam śā·mê·ḥū śim·ḥaṯ yə·rū·šā·lim wat·tiš·šā·ma‘ mê·rā·ḥō·wq
verses.literal: On that day they offered great sacrifices rejoicing because God had given them great joy . . . The women and children also rejoiced so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard from afar

verses.original: הַה֨וּא בַיּוֹם֩ אֲנָשִׁ֜ים וַיִּפָּקְד֣וּ עַל־ הַנְּשָׁכ֗וֹת לָא֨וֹצָר֥וֹת לַתְּרוּמוֹת֮ לָרֵאשִׁ֣ית וְלַמַּֽעַשְׂרוֹת֒ מְנָא֣וֹת הַתּוֹרָ֔ה לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם לִכְנ֨וֹס בָּהֶ֜ם לִשְׂדֵ֤י הֶעָרִים֙ כִּ֚י יְהוּדָ֔ה שִׂמְחַ֣ת עַל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְעַל־ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם הָעֹמְדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū ḇay·yō·wm ’ă·nā·šîm way·yip·pā·qə·ḏū ‘al- han·nə·šā·ḵō·wṯ lā·’ō·w·ṣā·rō·wṯ lat·tə·rū·mō·wṯ lā·rê·šîṯ wə·lam·ma·‘aś·rō·wṯ mə·nā·’ō·wṯ hat·tō·w·rāh lak·kō·hă·nîm wə·lal·wî·yim liḵ·nō·ws bā·hem liś·ḏê he·‘ā·rîm kî yə·hū·ḏāh śim·ḥaṯ ‘al- hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·‘al- hal·wî·yim hā·‘ō·mə·ḏîm
verses.literal: And on that same day men were appointed over the rooms that housed the supplies contributions firstfruits and tithes The portions [specified] by the Law for the priests and Levites were gathered into [these storerooms] from the fields of the villages because Judah rejoiced over the priests . . . and Levites who were serving

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְר֞וּ מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶם֙ וּמִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַֽטָּהֳרָ֔ה וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים דָּוִ֖יד בְנֽוֹ׃ שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה כְּמִצְוַ֥ת
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·rū miš·me·reṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem ū·miš·me·reṯ haṭ·ṭā·ho·rāh wə·ham·šō·rə·rîm wə·haš·šō·‘ă·rîm dā·wîḏ ḇə·nōw šə·lō·mōh kə·miṣ·waṯ
verses.literal: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification along with the singers and gatekeepers as David and his son Solomon had prescribed

verses.original: כִּֽי־ מִקֶּ֑דֶם בִימֵ֥י דָוִ֛יד וְאָסָ֖ף רֹאשׁ הַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים וְשִׁיר־ תְּהִלָּ֥ה וְהֹד֖וֹת לֵֽאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- miq·qe·ḏem ḇî·mê ḏā·wîḏ wə·’ā·sāp̄ rōš ham·šō·rə·rîm wə·šîr- tə·hil·lāh wə·hō·ḏō·wṯ lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: For long ago in the days of David and Asaph there were directors for the singers and for the songs of praise and thanksgiving to God

verses.original: בִּימֵ֨י זְרֻבָּבֶ֜ל וּבִימֵ֣י נְחֶמְיָ֗ה וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֩ נֹֽתְנִ֛ים מְנָי֛וֹת הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֥ים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִ֖ים וּמַקְדִּשִׁים֙ י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֑וֹ דְּבַר־ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם מַקְדִּשִׁ֖ים לִבְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: bî·mê zə·rub·bā·ḇel ū·ḇî·mê nə·ḥem·yāh wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl nō·ṯə·nîm mə·nā·yō·wṯ ham·šō·rə·rîm wə·haš·šō·‘ă·rîm ū·maq·di·šîm yō·wm bə·yō·w·mōw də·ḇar- lal·wî·yim wə·hal·wî·yim maq·di·šîm liḇ·nê ’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: So in the days of Zerubbabel and Nehemiah all Israel contributed the daily portions for the singers and gatekeepers They also set aside daily . . . portions for the Levites and the Levites set aside daily portions for the descendants of Aaron
